about.sectionTitle: People-Focused HR with a Marketing Perspective
paragraphs: I am an MBA in Human Resources and Marketing with practical internship exposure across HR operations and sales support. My experience includes recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, HR documentation, attendance and leave records, training support, internal communication, and customer-facing sales activities.

My B.A. in English has strengthened my communication, writing, and organizational approach. Through internships at Hedge Equities and Uralungal Labour Contract Co-operative Society, I supported day-to-day HR activities, while my time at Hilite Business Park gave me exposure to customer interaction, promotional materials, feedback collection, and product demonstrations.

I am a quick learner and proactive team player who values accuracy, clear communication, and collaboration. I am looking to grow in a dynamic organization where I can contribute to HR, people support, marketing, or sales-support responsibilities while continuing to learn.
